globalSettings.subtitle: Settings here apply to every model. To adjust a single model, go to Connect Management

record.affects: Affects: how much detail the call history keeps — only who called, or also the prompt and the answer.
record.when: When to change: "Metadata only" saves the most space. Raise it to "Summary" or "Full" only when you need to investigate a wrong answer.

lb.affects: Affects: which model takes a given request — picked at random, split by weight, or always the same one.
lb.when: When to change: usually leave it alone. If one model is overloaded, or you want traffic spread evenly across vendors, set the strategy per virtual model instead.

circuit.affects: Affects: after a model fails several times in a row, the gateway takes it out of rotation for a while so requests are not sent into a black hole.
circuit.when: When to change: turn it on when upstream providers are unstable. If the model recovers slowly, raise the failure threshold.

quota.affects: Affects: where usage is recorded, and whether requests are let through or rejected when the ledger errors out.
quota.when: When to change: to make hourly or monthly limits actually enforce, the ledger must be on. Leaving it off is fine if you only need the daily limit.

globalSettings.defaultsFooter: These are gateway-wide defaults. To adjust a single model, go to Connect Management → Model Management.
